A Pentomino Puzzle. It is created by using the OpenLayers Mapping API. Move, rotate and reflect the 12 pieces to find a solution for the rectangles layout.
The Voucherify mashup allows to sell vouchers or coupons for through Shopify. Vouchers can be useful for exams, therapy sessions, and gift cards.
TXT Beer is an app to quickly and easily get a beer's rating through SMS messaging. All you do is text the beer's name found on the label.

www.jobsdbcenter.com is a jobs listing mashup site using indeed and google map API . we use also payscale for salary research.

Free online flash games integrated with Twitter auth for keeping track of high scores.
InstaMe is a simple way to see pictures posted on Instagram. Allows everyone to enjoy the Instagram experience, not just iPhone users.
Satirical humor site about payday loans. Mashup helps predatory lenders find people who might take out payday loans.

On Webtomap you can post and discuss your local news, photos and videos. You can select content by tag and rating to find the stuff you like. All items posted on webtomap can be easily shared on all major social networks. To start adding your stuff to the map, login with Facebook, Twitter and Google.
Kijiji is a group of local, community-based classifieds websites.
The history of professional and major league sports teams in a Google Gadget. Each day of the year features a professional sports team from the past or present.

BadgePLZ is an Instagram widget for websites.
Toronto Live Club Hub helps locals and visitors find out where to find live music in the Toronto area via maps and integrated links to club listings.

OSCity (Open Source City) brings the Dutch spatial planning together with the newest information technology. By directly searching, visualizing and combining spatial data everybody is invited - from citizen, entrepreneur, designer and civil servant - to gain insight into everything that is spatial.
Soccer National league tables in a map, plus soccer news. You can search based on teams and leagues.

Funtimeplanner helps users plan trips by providing information on the top events and venues across the UK.
DocuSign is an online electronic signature service. It is integrated with Box.net, so users can send files to be e-signed with DocuSign from within the Box.net environment.
